soil.title: Soil investigation and parameters
soil.description: SPT, CPT and laboratory data, soil classification, layering, engineering parameters and soil profiles.
soil.placeholder: This section's screens will be moved into this module in a later step.
soil.layering.intro: The program proposes layer boundaries; nothing is approved. You review the proposal and then create a profile from it. Design parameters stay unset until you approve them.
soil.layering.no_sources.cpt: The project has no CPT soundings. Import one in Site data first.
soil.layering.no_sources.spt: The project has no boreholes. Import one in Site data first.
soil.layering.setting.n_change_ratio: SPT: relative N change for a new layer
soil.layering.not_approved: Proposal only. Nothing is approved automatically.
soil.layering.gamma_needed: No unit weight could be suggested for these layers. Enter γ for every layer: it is stored as supplied by you, not as a program suggestion.
soil.layering.gwt_hint: Required. Prefilled from the sounding when it recorded one; check it.
soil.layering.create_blocked: Enter every unit weight, the groundwater depth and a name first.
soil.layering.stale: Settings changed: propose again to refresh the table.
soil.params.title: Engineering parameters
soil.params.subtitle: Per layer: candidates from correlations and laboratory data, your selection, and approval. Only approved values become design values.
soil.params.no_profiles: There are no soil profiles yet. Create one in Soil profiles first.
soil.params.suggest_all_hint: Refreshes candidates and suggestions for every layer. Nothing is approved.
soil.params.approve_ready_hint: Approves every value of this layer that has an applied selection and is not yet approved.
soil.params.stale_hint: The layer bounds or inputs changed after approval on {date}. The old value ({value}) is no longer approved: select again and re-approve.
soil.params.revoked_hint: Changing the selection revokes its approval.
soil.params.no_candidates: No applicable correlation or laboratory value for this layer.
soil.params.no_suggestion: The program has no suggestion for this value.
soil.params.k_sd_hint: Required; the program does not default it.
soil.params.unapplied: Unapplied changes: apply the selection before approving.
soil.params.pick_needed: Choose how to select a value.
